name: resume-interrupted-installer-update
title: Resume installer updates interrupted before workflow replacement (A-013)
description: Close audit finding A-013: an installer update interrupted after the pending manifest write but before the workflow file is replaced leaves a pending manifest recording the new workflow hash while disk still holds the old workflow; the strict modification guard then misreads this installer-owned pending state as operator drift and refuses to resume. Scope the modification guard to active manifests so pending (mid-transaction) state resumes.
creator: sdelmas
